description: Nx alone chooses which CI lanes run for pull requests, queue groups and main pushes (nxSelectsAlone; emptying it restores the union with the planner). Every lane runs when the history or Nx fails, a task maps to no lane, or a path is under an unknown top-level entry. A main push the merge queue validated (--queue-verified) never calls Nx; on other main pushes the native app builds run only for a native build input (owner decision A2). Nightly and full runs keep the planner's selection. A lane only Nx selects gets complete inputs (build targets for both apps).
